AddFace.description:
## Feature Description  
The AddFace feature allows you to add facial data to a specified database. A single facial database supports a maximum of 50,000 facial images. Facial data is added to existing facial samples, and each facial sample can contain up to 5 facial images.  
Scaling out the maximum number of facial images per database or per facial sample is not supported.  

> - You can obtain online assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- For questions about API integration, usage, or other inquiries related to Visual AI capabilities of Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence Open Platform, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.  

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Create a Free Account** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the feature**: Ensure that you have activated the [FaceBody service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If you have not activated the service, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).  

><notice>  
This feature is available to users who have completed either enterprise or individual verification. For more information about identity verification, see [Identity Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).  
></notice>  

3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure that you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using an AccessKey of a RAM user, you must grant the RAM user the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission. For more information, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Prerequisites**:  
   - You have created a database by calling the [CreateFaceDb](~~159141~~) API and obtained the database name (DbName).  
   - You have created an entity by calling the [AddFaceEntity](~~161144~~) API and obtained the Entity ID (EntityId).  

5. **Online debugging (optional)**: You can debug the feature online by using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/AddFace?lang=JAVA) to view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the complete project.  
6. **Integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [Overview of SDKs](~~145033~~).  
   - Install the SDK package for the FaceBody category in the documentation for your selected language.  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  

7. **Sample code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages for this feature, see [Sample code for AddFace](~~477964~~).  

8. **Direct client invocation**: Common methods for direct client invocation of this feature include the following:

   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Restrictions  
- **Image format**: JPG, JPEG, PNG.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 5 MB.  
- **Image resolution**: Greater than 32 × 32 pixels and less than 4096 × 4096 pixels. The face in the image must occupy at least 64 × 64 pixels.  
- **URL**: Must not contain Chinese characters.  
- If an image contains multiple faces, the largest face will be selected for addition.  

> If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, scale down the image first. For more information, see [Image scaling](~~44688~~).  

## Limits  
By default, the AddFace API supports a maximum of 2 queries per second (QPS) for concurrent job submissions.  

## Billing  
The AddFace feature can be invoked free of charge.

CompareFace.description:
## Feature Description  
The 1:1 face comparison feature compares the largest faces detected in two input images to determine whether they belong to the same person.  
- **Compare two face images**: Measures the similarity between faces in two images and returns the bounding box coordinates of each face, the coordinates of five facial landmark points, the confidence level of the comparison, and confidence thresholds corresponding to different false acceptance rates.  
- **Supports multiple image types**: Supports comparison of faces in casual photos, ID photos, chip-based ID photos, and photos with screen patterns.

The following figure illustrates this API’s functionality:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221227/ghxo/CompareFace.png" width="500)

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- You can experience this capability for free on the Visual Intelligence API platform. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=CompareFace) for an intuitive trial or to purchase the service online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us directly.

## Common Scenarios  
- **Finance**: Compare a user’s ID photo with an authorized on-site captured photo to verify the authenticity of user information. This enables fast and secure identity verification suitable for remote account opening and facial recognition payments in financial services.  
- **Employee attendance**: Contactless facial recognition attendance is ideal for enterprise use during epidemic prevention scenarios and effectively prevents proxy check-ins and other fraudulent behaviors.  
- **Public services**: Customers can complete transactions by simply using facial recognition. Identity verification through face comparison eliminates steps such as ID inspection, photocopying, and archiving, significantly improving efficiency at public service counters.  
- **Hotel self-check-in**: Guests can check in autonomously by facial recognition. The system performs 1:1 face comparison between an on-site authorized photo and the photo extracted from the guest’s ID to ensure identity authenticity while reducing manual verification, service costs, and enhancing the guest experience.

## Key Advantages  
- **High-accuracy recognition**: The face detection and recognition algorithm achieves industry-leading accuracy.  
- **Stable platform service**: Delivers millisecond-level recognition response and reliability even under high concurrency and heavy traffic.  
- **Precise facial landmark localization**: Accurately locates key facial features such as eyes, nose, and mouth with high precision.  
- **Simple and easy to use**: Offers straightforward API integration with strong compatibility, making it easy to embed into applications.

DeepfakeFace.title: Deepfake Face Detection
DeepfakeFace.description:
## Feature Description  
Deepfake Face Detection uses AI-based image algorithms to sensitively detect and deeply analyze the authenticity of human faces in images. This capability supports the following:

1. Detecting whether a face in an image is a deepfake generated by AI-based face-swapping algorithms.
2. Detecting whether a face in an image is a deepfake generated by AI-based facial attribute editing algorithms. Deepfake technology refers to techniques that leverage deep learning to swap faces or edit facial features in images or videos.

Example images illustrating this API's functionality are shown below:

- Not synthesized by algorithms:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231109/kpoj/real2.png)  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231109/rvyz/real1.jpg)

- Synthesized by algorithms:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231109/vcgh/fake1.png)  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20231109/xgjj/fake2.png)

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=DeepfakeFace) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase the service online.
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us directly.

## Common Scenarios  
- Combating the spread of deepfake videos online: With the surge in popularity of entertainment-focused face-swapping miniapps and mobile applications, deepfake detection technology can identify forged faces in short online videos, preventing video-based identity fraud.
- Preventing online ID-based face-swapping scams: Deepfake technology is frequently exploited in combination with social media to manipulate public opinion and facilitate fraud. Deepfake detection can identify forged facial videos used in online identity verification processes, thereby reducing internet fraud.
- Disrupting illicit industries such as pornography and cyber underground economy chains: The Internet hosts a vast volume of deepfake-generated pornographic content. Deepfake detection helps identify such forged videos, curbing the dissemination of non-consensual deepfake pornography and breaking distribution chains.
- Detecting facial feature editing: To verify copyright ownership of real-person identities, deepfake detection identifies deepfake images in Material Libraries that were generated using facial attribute editing algorithms, preventing identity forgery and copyright infringement.

## Key Advantages  
- Countering AI misuse: Built upon DAMO Academy’s facial image algorithms and deepfake detection technology, this service performs comprehensive analysis of facial features in images. It leverages AI to counteract the misuse of technologies such as face swapping, synthetic face generation, and facial feature editing, thereby protecting user rights and maintaining public safety.
- Leading detection technology: By analyzing high-dimensional, full-spectrum features of human subjects in images—from low-level pixel and texture details to high-level global semantic features—the service conducts multilayer, high-semantic, holistic analysis. Its integrated attack-and-defense training methodology significantly improves detection rates for synthetic faces.
- High accuracy: Combining Alibaba Cloud’s years of expertise in facial recognition and big data security technologies, this service accurately identifies AI-generated faces and deepfakes in images and videos, achieving high precision in detecting deepfake attacks.
- Supports detection logic for single or multiple faces. The service provides easy-to-use, directly invocable API operations that are simple to integrate and highly compatible.

## Integration Guide  
1. Register an Alibaba Cloud account: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.
2. Activate the service: Ensure you have activated the [Face and Body Service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If not yet activated, click [Activate Now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).
> This capability is available to both enterprise and individual users who have completed identity verification. For more information on identity verification, see [Identity Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).
3. Create an AccessKey: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, grant the RAM user the AliyunVIAPIFullAccess permission. For details, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).
4. Online debugging (optional): You can debug this capability using [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/DeepfakeFace) to view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.
5. Development integration steps:
   - Select your preferred programming language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).
   - Install the SDK package under the facebody category in the corresponding language’s SDK documentation.
   - Modify and invoke the API based on the provided sample code.
6. Direct client invocation: Common client-side invocation methods include:
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)

## Input Restrictions  
- Image formats: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP.
- Image size: No larger than 10 MB.
- Image resolution: Recommended to be greater than 256×256 pixels, with the facial region larger than 128×128 pixels. Lower resolutions may negatively impact detection performance.
- URLs must not contain Chinese characters.

> If the image resolution exceeds the recommended limit, resize the image first. For details, see [Image Scaling](~~44688~~).

## Detection Notes  
- Maximum detection time is 5 seconds. If detection is not completed within this period, the system returns a timeout error code.
- Image download time is limited to 3 seconds. If downloading takes longer, the system returns a download timeout error.
- The API response time depends on the image download time. Ensure the storage service hosting the image is stable and reliable. We recommend using Alibaba Cloud OSS or Alibaba Cloud CDN for caching.
- Up to 10 images can be processed per request.

## Reference Thresholds for Deepfake Face Detection
By default, the returned **Label** is determined by a confidence level threshold of 50. If the confidence level is below 50, the **Label** is `normalface`; if above 50, the **Label** is `deepfakeface`.  
Confidence level represents the model's certainty, ranging from [0,100]. A lower value indicates a higher probability that the face is genuine. You can adjust the confidence threshold according to your specific scenario for more flexible usage. Internal experimental reference data is shown below.

| Confidence Threshold | Fake Face Block Rate | Genuine Face Pass Rate |
| ---- | ------------ | ---- |
|15   |98.21%  |80.27%   |
|30   |97.56%  |87.59%   |
|40   |97.04%  |90.67%   |
|50 (default)   |95.09%  |96.61%   |
|60   |92.50%  |98.13%   |
|70   |90.59%  |98.77%   |

Definitions of the metrics above:
- Fake Face Block Rate: For example, 98% means that out of 100 fake face attacks, 98 are correctly identified and denied by the API.
- Genuine Face Pass Rate: For example, 98% means that out of 100 genuine face requests, 98 successfully pass liveness verification.

> Internal experimental data is provided for reference only.

items.description: The probability that the screenshot contains a face, with values ranging from 0 to 1. If multiple faces are present, probabilities are returned in sequence. For example, if two faces exist, the response is `[face_prob1, face_prob2]`. A higher value indicates a larger facial area resolution, clearer facial details, and a more frontal view of the face.

left-top: The top-left corner of the bounding box, using the image’s top-left corner as the coordinate origin (x, y). This point is x pixels from the left border and y pixels from the top border of the image.  
width-height: The width and height of the bounding box.  
The bounding box area equals width × height, and its bottom-right coordinate is (left + width, top + height).

Returns the face pose angles in the format `[yaw, pitch, roll]`. If multiple faces are detected, the angles are listed in order.

- Yaw represents the left-right angle, with a range of -90 to 90 degrees.  
- Pitch represents the up-down angle, with a range of -90 to 90 degrees.  
- Roll represents the in-plane rotation angle, with a range of -180 to 180 degrees.

The facial feature point localization result. Each face returns a group of feature point coordinates in the format `(x0, y0, x1, y1, ...)`. If multiple faces are present, their coordinates are appended sequentially as floating-point numbers.

DetectFace.description:
## Feature Description  
The face detection and facial landmark localization feature can detect faces in an image and provide precise bounding boxes and 105 facial landmarks for each detected face. It outputs information such as the number of faces, face rectangle coordinates, face pose, coordinates of both pupils' centers, and a list of confidence levels. It supports comprehensive quality scoring based on occlusion, illumination, blur, pose, and noise, and can detect multiple faces in various poses within a single image.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- This feature is available for a full free trial on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=DetectFace) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or other questions about Alibaba Cloud's Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  
Facial landmark detection serves as the foundation for subsequent recognition, analysis, and effect-based applications. It provides precise facial information essential for facial recognition, expression analysis, fatigue detection, 3D face reconstruction, retouching, face swapping, and other face-related applications.

- **Interactive Entertainment Applications**: Enables accurate localization of facial features and contours to support dynamic stickers, short video effects, special-effect cameras, and other interactive entertainment features.  
- **Retouching Photography**: High-precision facial landmarks enable advanced retouching and reshaping, applicable across scenarios such as photo editing, video processing, and interactive streams.  
- **Facial Localization and Analysis**: Supports precise facial contour localization and keypoint analysis, enabling high-value applications in intelligent aesthetic medicine and smart mobile apps.

## Key Advantages  

- **High-Precision Localization**: Accurately locates facial features including eyebrows, eyes, pupils, nose, and mouth.  
- **Strong Adaptability**: Performs reliably across diverse photos and face sizes, supporting profiles up to 90 degrees and full 360-degree in-plane rotation.  
- **Multi-Face Support**: Detects multiple faces in a single image, suitable for high-precision scenarios such as face editing, face swapping, and pose correction.  
- **Image Quality Scoring**: Provides a comprehensive quality score based on occlusion, illumination, blur, pose, and noise.  
- **Stable Platform Service**: Delivers millisecond-level response times with guaranteed reliability under high concurrency and heavy traffic.

DetectInfraredLivingFace.title: Infrared Face Liveness Detection
DetectInfraredLivingFace.description:
## Feature Description  
The infrared face liveness detection capability can determine whether a face in an infrared image is a live human face captured directly (without post-processing) at close range from an authenticated device. This capability is widely applicable in real-time infrared face capture scenarios and meets the authenticity and security requirements for infrared face registration and authentication. A prerequisite for this detection is that the infrared image must contain a human face.  

In terms of capability scope:  
1. **Authenticated devices** refer to hardware devices equipped with infrared cameras that capture close-range, unprocessed frontal live human faces for use in authentication, access control, and similar service scenarios. Common examples include access control terminals, attendance machines, PCs, and other intelligent terminal authentication devices.  
2. **Unprocessed frontal live human faces** refer to genuine human faces captured in raw infrared images without heavy post-processing such as extensive Photoshop editing, stylization, or artificial synthesis. The face must be frontal, clear, unobscured, and not captured at extreme angles. Common non-live examples include printed paper faces and 3D model faces.  

Example images illustrating this API’s functionality are shown below:  
- Live human face  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20230202/dsjz/DetectInfraredLivingFacezhenren.png" width="400)  
- Printed paper face  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20230202/gfgt/DetectInfraredLivingFacezhizhang.png" width="400)  

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- You can experience this capability for free on the Visual Intelligence API platform. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=DetectInfraredLivingFace) for an intuitive trial or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.  

## Common Scenarios  
- **System face login attack prevention**: By detecting whether the uploaded infrared image is a genuine live capture rather than a spoofed or post-processed photo (e.g., screen replay or Photoshop), this feature prevents attackers from logging into the system and introducing security risks.  
- **Access control via facial recognition at gates and locks**: Real-time infrared liveness detection on device endpoints during face registration and authentication ensures live human verification, preventing unauthorized individuals from impersonating others using stolen or forged identities.  
- **Smart hotel self-check-in**: In self-service hotel check-in scenarios, infrared liveness detection efficiently blocks non-live attacks (such as printed paper faces or electronic screen replays) in unsupervised environments.  

## Key Advantages  
- **High-accuracy anti-spoofing**: Leverages high-dimensional features of the human subject in the image (e.g., stylization artifacts, moiré patterns, imaging distortions) to determine liveness. Effectively prevents cheating attacks such as screen replays and supports logic based on single or multiple images.  
- **High-sensitivity blocking**: Supports real-time liveness detection on infrared camera devices, effectively blocking attacks using replays, head models, or printed photos.  
- **Wide applicability**: Especially suitable for scenarios with poor visible lighting, such as smart door locks.  
- **Simple and easy to use**: Offers a directly invocable API that is straightforward to integrate and highly compatible.  

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the capability**: Ensure you have activated the [Face and Body service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If not, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).  
><notice>  
This capability is available only to users who have completed enterprise verification. For more information on identity verification, see [Identity Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).  
></notice>  

3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, grant the RAM user the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission. For details, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/DetectInfraredLivingFace?lang=JAVA) to debug the capability online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the Face and Body (`facebody`) category.  
   - Modify and invoke the API using the sample code provided in the documentation.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used programming languages, see [DetectInfraredLivingFace Sample Code](~~601305~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods include:  
   - [Direct invocation from web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Restrictions  
- **Image formats**: PNG, JPG, JPEG, BMP, GIF, WEBP.  
- **Image size**: Must not exceed 10 MB.  
- **Image resolution**: Recommended to be greater than 256 × 256 pixels. Lower resolutions may degrade detection accuracy.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.  
> If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, resize the image first. For details, see [Image Scaling](~~44688~~).  

## Detection Notes  
- The maximum detection duration is 5 seconds. If detection is not completed within this time, the system returns a timeout error code.  
- Image download is limited to 3 seconds. If download exceeds this limit, the system returns a download timeout error.  
- The API response time depends on the image download time. Ensure the storage service hosting the image is stable and reliable. We recommend using Alibaba Cloud OSS or Alibaba Cloud CDN for caching.  
- Up to 10 images can be processed in a single request.  
- The current liveness detection offered by the platform is passive (i.e., based solely on static images). It does not support active liveness checks requiring actions such as head shaking, mouth opening, or blinking.

For selecting the threshold in image-based liveness detection, refer to the following table:

| Label | Rate Threshold | Attack Block Rate | Liveness Pass Rate |
| ---- | ------------ | ---- | ------------ |
|liveness     |0.39       |98.18%   |90.21%      |

|liveness     |0.7      |98.94%   |88.36%      |

When the Label is "normal," it indicates a live face. The Rate represents the confidence level of liveness, with a value range of [80, 100].  
When the Label is "liveness," it indicates a non-live face (spoofing attempt). The Rate represents the confidence level of non-liveness, with a value range of [20, 100].

Definitions of the metrics above:
- **Attack Block Rate**: For example, 98% means that out of 100 spoofing attacks using fake artifacts, 98 are correctly identified and denied by the API.
- **Liveness Pass Rate**: For example, 98% means that out of 100 genuine user requests, 98 successfully pass liveness verification.

- **Detail Enhancement**: Enhances fine details in the original image. Even when the source image quality is poor, the algorithm can recover partial details and improve overall photo quality.  
- **Facial Consistency**: While enhancing details, it maintains consistency and realism with the original facial appearance.

- **Supported styles**: Chinese ink painting (NEW), Hong Kong comics (NEW), comic style (NEW), 3D animation (NEW), Japanese manga, 3D, hand-drawn, pencil sketch, and artistic effects—nine styles in total.  
- **Group photos**: Supports conversion of images containing multiple people, with up to five faces processed in a single image.

MergeImageFace.title: Merge facial images
MergeImageFace.description:
## Feature Description  
The image face fusion feature can merge the face from a user-provided image into the facial position of a template image, generating a new image that contains the facial features of the user's image. Please note that this feature strictly requires users to obtain prior authorization for both the user image and the template image, and must not be used in illegal or ethically inappropriate scenarios.  

An example illustration of this API feature is shown below:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221108/mzue/MergeImageFace.png" width="400)

> - You can access [online consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2) to receive live assistance.  
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=MergeImageFace) for an intuitive hands-on experience and online purchase.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  
- **Entertainment applications**: Users can fuse their own faces with authorized legal images of other individuals.  
- **Film and television production**: Suitable for film and TV production companies to improve efficiency and reduce costs during post-production by using face fusion.  
- **Photography studio customer acquisition**: Applicable to photo studios or individual photography workshops to fuse a customer’s face onto sample photographs, enabling virtual try-ons for makeup, outfits, or photo styles.

## Key Advantages  
- **High fidelity with natural results**: The fused face preserves the visual identity features of the source face while seamlessly blending into the target face without unnatural artifacts.  
- **Consistent expression and skin tone**: The fused face maximally retains the original facial expression and skin tone consistency of the target face.  
- **Supports complex facial angles**: Supports template faces rotated at certain angles, producing realistic and stable fusion results.  
- **Adaptive face shape matching**: Automatically matches the user’s face shape to enhance recognizability in the fused result.  
- **Supports multiple faces and selective fusion**: Handles multiple faces in the template image and allows specifying which target face each should be individually fused with.

## Integration Guide  

1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner of the page, click **Sign Up** and follow the instructions to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the capability**: Ensure you have activated the [Face and Body service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If not yet activated, [activate it now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).  

><notice>Users who activate this capability on or after July 17, 2024 can directly invoke the API without submitting a request.  
Users who activated this service before July 17, 2024 must contact us via DingTalk group (23109592) to be added to the whitelist before invoking the API.  
></notice>

3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/MergeImageFace?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=old&params=%7B%7D&tab=DEMO) to debug the capability online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, or download the full project.  
5. **Prerequisites**: You must have already created a `TemplateId` by calling the [AddFaceImageTemplate](~~203512~~) API.  
6. **Development integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred SDK language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - In the corresponding SDK documentation, locate and install the SDK package under the AI category "facebody".  
   - Modify the provided sample code as needed and invoke the API.  

7. **Sample Code**: Sample code in commonly used programming languages is available at [Image Face Fusion Sample Code](~~467963~~).  

8. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation from Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation from iOS](~~467782~~)  

## Input Constraints  
- **Image formats**: JPG, JPEG, PNG.  
- **Image size**: No larger than 20 MB.  
- **Image resolution**: Between 128×128 pixels and 2000×2000 pixels inclusive, with the longest edge no greater than 2000 pixels.  
- **URLs must not contain Chinese characters**.  

> If the image resolution exceeds the maximum limit, scale down the image first. For details, see [Image scaling](~~44688~~).

## Image Quality Recommendations  

- Ensure the face in the image is clear. The face size should be at least 64×64 pixels, and the face region should not exceed two-thirds of the entire image area.  
- It is recommended that facial contours be complete and unobstructed. The face fusion algorithm supports faces rotated at certain angles; optimal results are achieved when the rotation angle does not exceed 30 degrees.  
- For images containing multiple faces, it is recommended that the number of faces does not exceed five.  

Recommended image example:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221114/jris/MergeImageFacetuijian.png" width="300)  
Not recommended image example:  
![](https://static-aliyun-doc.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/file-manage-files/zh-CN/20221114/rkbx/MergeImageFacebutuijian.png" width="300)

The online invigilation capability can detect examinee behaviors during online exams, supporting detection of screen-based chat tools and examinee status.

- **Screen chat tool detection**: Input a screenshot image to determine whether common chat tools are present.  
- **Examinee status detection**: Use the front-facing camera of the examinee to capture images and analyze the number of faces and bodies, face orientation angle, whether headphones are worn, and whether a phone is being used.

RecognizeAction.title: Action Behavior Recognition
RecognizeAction.description:
## Feature Description  
The action behavior recognition capability can detect human actions in videos and images and return the corresponding behavior categories. The currently supported behavior categories include: raising hand, eating or drinking, smoking, making phone calls, using a mobile phone, sleeping on a desk, falling down, washing hands, and taking photos. You can determine whether an action has occurred based on the confidence level threshold provided by the system.

**Applicable Scenarios for Action Behavior Recognition:**  
- **Raising hand**: Arm fully extended upward with the wrist higher than the top of the head.  
- **Eating or drinking**: Consuming food or beverages.  
- **Smoking**: Lighting and actually smoking a cigarette; the smoke must be clearly visible in the image.  
- **Making phone calls**: Using a telephone or WeChat voice call, with the phone held close to the ear or mouth.  
- **Using a mobile phone**: Typing, browsing, watching videos, playing games, video chatting, or other mobile phone usage behaviors; the phone must be clearly visible in the image.  
- **Sleeping on a desk**: Head resting on a table while sleeping.  
- **Falling down**: Entire body collapsing onto the ground.  
- **Washing hands**: Washing hands under a faucet or in a basin.  
- **Taking photos**: Slightly raising a phone to take a photo of a person or object.

> - You can obtain live assistance by visiting [Online Consultation](https://www.aliyun.com/core/online-consult?from=aZgW6LJHr2).  
- A complete free trial of this capability is available on the Visual Intelligence API. Click [Try Now](https://vision.aliyun.com/experience/detail?&tagName=facebody&children=RecognizeAction) for an intuitive hands-on experience or to purchase online.  
- For inquiries regarding API integration, usage, or technical support for Alibaba Cloud’s Visual Intelligence API visual AI capabilities, please join our DingTalk group (23109592) to contact us.

## Common Scenarios  
- **Driver Monitoring System (DMS)**: Detects unsafe driving behaviors such as smoking, eating or drinking, making phone calls, or using a mobile phone.  
- **Learning Behavior Monitoring**: Monitors behaviors during study sessions, such as raising hands, using mobile phones, or sleeping on desks.  
- **Public Space Behavior Monitoring**: Detects uncivilized behaviors in museums, exhibition halls, and other public spaces—such as smoking, making phone calls, or taking photos—as well as abnormal events like falling down.  
- **Workplace Supervision**: Monitors workplace behaviors including eating or drinking, smoking, making phone calls, sleeping on desks, and verifies whether handwashing requirements are followed.

## Key Advantages  
- **Supports diverse application scenarios**: Recognizes behaviors such as raising hand, eating or drinking, smoking, making phone calls, using mobile phones, sleeping, falling down, washing hands, and taking photos, covering driving, learning, general security, and more.  
- **Adapts to various lighting conditions**: Performs reliably under natural light, indoor lighting, and night-time infrared modes.

## Integration Guide  
1. **Register an Alibaba Cloud account**: Go to the [Alibaba Cloud official website](https://www.aliyun.com). In the upper-right corner, click **Sign Up Now** and follow the prompts to complete registration.  
2. **Activate the service**: Ensure you have activated the [Face and Body Service](https://vision.aliyun.com/facebody). If not yet activated, click [Activate Now](https://common-buy.aliyun.com/?commodityCode=viapi_facebody_public_cn#/open).

> This capability is available to both enterprise and individual verification users. For more information about identity verification, see [Identity Verification](https://help.aliyun.com/knowledge_list/37170.html).

3. **Create an AccessKey**: Ensure you have [created an AccessKey](~~175144~~). If you are using a RAM user AccessKey, assign the `AliyunVIAPIFullAccess` permission to the RAM user. For details, see [RAM Authorization](~~145025~~).  
4. **Online debugging (optional)**: Use [OpenAPI Explorer](https://next.api.aliyun.com/api/facebody/2019-12-30/RecognizeAction?lang=JAVA&sdkStyle=old&params=%7B%22Type%22%3A1%2C%22URLList%22%3A%5B%7B%22URL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FRecognizeAction%2F1RecognizeAction1.png%22%7D%2C%7B%22URL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FRecognizeAction%2F1RecognizeAction2.png%22%7D%2C%7B%22URL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FRecognizeAction%2F1RecognizeAction3.png%22%7D%2C%7B%22URL%22%3A%22http%3A%2F%2Fviapi-test.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com%2Fviapi-3.0domepic%2Ffacebody%2FRecognizeAction%2F1RecognizeAction4.png%22%7D%5D%7D&tab=DEMO) to debug the capability online, view complete sample code and SDK dependency information, and download the full project.  
5. **Development integration steps**:  
   - Select your preferred programming language from the [SDK Overview](~~145033~~).  
   - Install the SDK package under the Face and Body (`facebody`) category in the corresponding language documentation.  
   - Modify and invoke the API based on the sample code provided in the documentation.  

6. **Sample Code**: For sample code in commonly used languages, see [Action Behavior Recognition Sample Code](~~478479~~).  

7. **Direct client invocation**: Common client-side invocation methods include:  
   - [Direct invocation from Web frontend](~~467779~~)  
   - [Direct invocation in miniapp scenarios](~~467780~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on Android](~~467781~~)  
   - [Direct invocation on iOS](~~467782~~)

## Input Constraints  

- **Video requirements**:  
    1. Duration must be greater than 2 seconds and less than 5 seconds. If the input video exceeds 5 seconds, the system returns detection results only for the first 5 seconds.  
    2. File size must be less than 10 MB.  
    3. Resolution must be greater than 256 × 256 pixels and no more than 1280 × 720 pixels.  
    4. Supported common video formats include MPEG, AVI, MOV, and MP4.  

        > Recommended for home camera or close-range monitoring scenarios—i.e., fixed cameras capturing subjects at distances between 2 meters and 10 meters.  

- **Image requirements**:  
    1. Must consist of 4 frames, extracted uniformly over 2 consecutive seconds from the same video. Submitting 4 frames from different videos will result in an error.  
    2. Resolution must be greater than 256 × 256 pixels and no more than 1280 × 720 pixels.  
    3. Supported formats are JPEG, PNG, BMP, and JPG.  
    4. Mixed input of URLs and Base64-encoded strings is allowed.  

- URLs must not contain Chinese characters.

- Roll represents the in-plane rotation angle, ranging from -180 to 180 degrees.

The public figure recognition feature can identify public figures in images.  
Public figures refer to individuals who have significant influence within a certain scope, hold a certain social status, receive widespread public attention, derive substantial benefits from society, and are closely related to public interest—such as political leaders, scientists, entrepreneurs, or social activists.

- Ensure that the source of uploaded images or files complies with applicable laws and regulations.  
- Temporary files uploaded during debugging expire after 1 hour and are automatically cleaned up and deleted by the system after 24 hours.  
- The platform does not store original facial images or file information involved during your use of the service.  
- The platform freezes facial characteristic vector data for users who have not performed any API service invocation for six months or longer, to ensure the security of customer information when no service is in use. If you need to restore the data, contact us via DingTalk group (23109592).
